correctness.rationale: Exact recurrences M_{2n}=JM_nU, M_{2n+1}=JM_nV reduce normalized B_n to M_1 times products in SL₂(Z/m), odd m>=3. Elementary unipotents generate SL₂; return lengths m and 4(m+1) are coprime so the finite uniform walk is mixing. Uniform bounds on complete dyadic cylinders, including arbitrary initial segments, establish natural densities over det −2 matrices. Counting m completions of each primitive first column gives uniform (s(n),t(n)), while alternating determinant sign on binary blocks yields exactly 1/(3G_m) and 2/(3G_m) raw-matrix lower and upper frequencies. Independent direct recurrences checked 32764 n-modulus determinant identities.
